label: Formation overpressure
engineering_rationale: Overpressure is a property of the rock at a depth, so formation match and TVD lead and the mud programme follows, since underbalanced drilling into an overpressured unit is how the hazard is created. Surface distance outranks shared event history because a nearby well may share the pressure communication without having recorded the event.
references: Saaty, T.L. (1980). The Analytic Hierarchy Process. McGraw-Hill, New York.
API RP 65, Well Control and Production Safety Operations (2nd ed., API).
